episodes.title: If It's to Be
episodes.summary: Young Aaron grows up with high aspirations and immense pressure for his football career; when tragedy strikes, his fate falls into new hands.

episodes.title: Consequences with Extreme Prejudice
episodes.summary: Aaron faces college level competition on the field and distractions off of it; he learns that the rules work differently when you're a team asset.

episodes.title: Pray the Gay Away
episodes.summary: Aaron's star status brings him acclaim but he struggles to resist hidden temptations and seeks counsel from an unlikely source.

episodes.title: Birthday Money
episodes.summary: Aaron prepares for the NFL Draft with high hopes, but secrets from his past threaten to unravel his NFL prospects.

episodes.title: The Man
episodes.summary: "Patriot Way," Aaron reconnects with an old love interest and seeks out a dangerous new friend.

episodes.title: Herald Street
episodes.summary: As his NFL stardom rises, Aaron commits a violent act that casts a haunting shadow over his picture-perfect life.

episodes.title: Dirty Pain
episodes.summary: Fearing for his life, Aaron goes to California for surgery and a fresh start but he cannot escape his growing paranoia.

episodes.title: Odin
episodes.summary: When tragic news sends Aaron deeper into his mental turmoil, he tries to find reprieve in an ill-fated new friendship.

episodes.title: What's Left Behind
episodes.summary: With Aaron behind bars, the women in his life are forced to face their new reality and make a difficult decision.

episodes.title: Who Killed Aaron Hernandez?
episodes.summary: New lawyers and a second trial offer unexpected hope, but Aaron's tortured mind struggles to withstand the weight of his deepest secrets.
